title: [29.X]-[CH] SEPA XML Files should append the Address 1 + '' + Address 2 fields under <PstlAdr><StrtNm> node if we use "Address 2" as Building Number for QR-Bills
summary: In the Swiss localization, SEPA XML payment exports now write Address 1 followed by Address 2 into the PstlAdr/StrtNm node when Address 2 is used as the building number for QR-Bills.
key_points: StrtNm in SEPA XML now combines Address 1 and Address 2 when Address 2 holds the building number for QR-Bills
Change is in the CH layer of the Payment Export Data table
Tests added to the Swiss SEPA credit transfer export test codeunits
